name: ai-workflow
description: Stable AI workflow skills for plan grilling, domain-aware decision capture, planning, slicing, orchestration, implementation, refactoring, two-axis review, repair, Jira-native plan and checkpoint sync, draft PR publishing, and change summary handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Grill plans, capture domain decisions, slice, orchestrate, sync Jira-native plans and checkpoints, implement, review, repair, publish draft PRs, and summarize AI-assisted work.
interface.longDescription: Vendor-neutral workflow skills for stress-testing plans, capturing confirmed domain decisions in local documentation, turning planning context into execution plans, approved implementation slices, local workflow orchestration, Jira-native planning and checkpoint synchronization, bounded implementation handoffs, scoped refactor summaries, independent Standards and Spec review summaries, validated repair summaries, explicit draft PR publishing, and concise change summary handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use grill-me to interview me in rounds and resolve this plan before creating an execution plan.
Use grill-with-docs to challenge this plan against the repository's domain language and documented decisions.
Use create-execution-plan to turn this planning context into an execution plan.
Use create-implementation-slices to break this execution plan into implementation slices.
Use run-workflow to coordinate approved slices through implementation, refactor, review, repair, and local human review handoff.
Use jira-plan-import to import an execution plan from a Jira Epic/Story description and slices from child Stories or Sub-tasks into local artifacts.
Use jira-plan-sync to sync an approved execution plan and selected slices into Jira descriptions and child work items.
Use jira-checkpoint-sync to sync implementation summaries, workflow checkpoints, terminal state, and optional draft PR backlinks into Jira.
Use implement-scope to implement this approved slice or concrete standalone request and write a handoff.
Use refactor to improve this implemented workflow or explicit boundary without changing behavior.
Use review to evaluate this implemented feature or code change through independent Standards and Spec axes and write a repair-ready summary.
Use repair-findings to repair eligible in-scope review findings and write a validation-backed summary.
Use summarize-changes to summarize implemented changes, review evidence, and validation in the standard PR overview format.
Use publish-draft-pr only after terminal workflow handoff and explicit authorization to publish a draft PR.
